BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the Bl-1 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-H in the area
bounded by


the alley next north of and parallel to west Belmont Avenue; A line 80.1 feet west

of and parallel to north Normandy Avenue; West Belmont Avenue; And a line

105.1 feet west of and parallel to north Normandy Avenue




to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.




SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage
and due publication.
